translation:
大黃 (dàhuáng) (General 將軍), greatly cold, non-toxic. It settles the stomach and descends qi (下氣), removes phlegm and repletion (痰實), bound heat between the intestines, fullness of the heart and abdomen, cold blood-closure and distension in women, and the lower abdomen...

The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 大黃 (dàhuáng), flavor bitter, cold. It governs descending stasis...
